_comment: Ported from PRON in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1156). Sign rules and a few sitter lines are written with {tokens} — see signs.json — that are filled in at DISPLAY time from the sitter's own "p" field, so one sentence reads correctly for he/she/they sitters without three copies of it. I18n.fill() does the substitution; an unknown token is left alone rather than blanked, so a typo shows up as {typo} instead of vanishing. A mod adds a pronoun set by adding a key here and using it as a sitter's "p". Note the verb-agreement tokens ({is}/{es}/{has}/{do}/{goes}): 'they' takes plural agreement, which is why the sentences are written as "{S} need{es} it" rather than hardcoding the -s.
